Conversation content on Day 53: [|User|]: You know who I am. I am enjoying the main character in You Know Who I Am. She is gutsy and strong but has a weakness that she must constantly battle. I am now reading book 2 in the series.
[|AI|]: For a first novel, I am speechless at how well you have done, dear author. The book is well written, and melds together easily. The characters are believable. The story is real while being unique. I have to agree with one of the reviewers here. I do sense a sequel coming on. So, let me just say, for my two cents' worth, the lawyer finds Dru very enticing, dear author. About time Dru and her sister have a nicer life. This is a story of Drusilla Thorne, her sister, and what they have run away from. They were forced to make new lives, using many aliases in their travels. We find Drusilla married to Colin, a handsome magician with a penchant for chasing anything in skirts, no holds barred. Colin, in the role of the True devil, is handsome and knows it. He uses his looks to help him get the women he wants. Colin decides it is time to leave Dru, so he walks out on his marriage right in the middle of their magic act. As he leaves, he takes Dru's bracelet which can lead people to Dru that are trying to find Dru and kill her. Dru can't let that happen. She has to find her bracelet. Dru finally finds Colin in Los Angeles. Problem is that he is dead.
